stem: Hana would like to add a closing sentence to the third paragraph (sentences 13–15) of her story. Which sentence can BEST follow sentence 15 and accomplish this goal?

options.label: A
options.text: They were so much tastier than any pineapple I’d ever gotten in the grocery store.

options.label: B
options.text: The toothpicks stood up tall as they stuck out of each piece of pineapple on the platter.

options.label: C
options.text: Most days of the year we would have yummy snacks and rotate between our two apartments.

options.label: D
options.text: It was really nice of Leilani and her mom to welcome me into their home after school.
